description: BAFU's nine remaining carbon dioxide rows, and the four defects they carried. Two are a missing registry number — the #127 pattern, corrected the same way: `Carbon dioxide, biogenic` at `low. pop.` minted a second biogenic carbon dioxide (#134), and `Carbon dioxide, land transformation` at `unspecified` fell to label matching (#136). Two need a curated target because no rule can reach one: `in air` is a compartment rather than an origin (#135), and the unqualified rows say nothing at all, their being fossil resting on evidence in BAFU's own datasets (#139 §17). Rows are selected by source uuid, not by name: BAFU spells one substance several ways and the merge records a place-stripped name for some rows, so a name selector conflates flows that this file is about keeping apart. Measured on a full build against merge base 09b1c37, where the carbon dioxide family ends up exactly as #139 §16 predicted — 17 biogenic, 16 fossil, 12 land use change, 8 carbon into a pool, 2 resource correction, and none at all on the substance that states no origin.

expectations.title: BAFU's three biogenic carbon dioxide rows reach the substance EF characterises
expectations.comment: Three rows, one per compartment. Two reached `Carbon Dioxide (biogenic)` already, on `cas+qualifier`; the `low. pop.` row carried no registry number, so the qualifier had nothing to narrow and the row minted a second biogenic carbon dioxide with one flow and no factor. Giving the name its number is what the other two already have. `same_substance` is the claim that matters — three rows of one substance reaching one substance.

expectations.title: There is no second biogenic carbon dioxide
expectations.comment: The negative half. Stated as an absence because that is what the fix produces: nothing renames the duplicate, it stops being created.

expectations.title: BAFU's carbon dioxide in air reaches EF's biogenic uptake from air
expectations.comment: `resources / in air`, the one of BAFU's three that carries 124-38-9. Its number found carbon dioxide and nothing in `in air` is a qualifier, so the label branch matched unqualified `Carbon Dioxide` — the substance that declines to say where the carbon came from. ecoinvent's flow of the same name already reaches this EF row through its own correspondence table, and #257 settled that as right. Both substance and compartment are claimed here because this is the row where the two agree.

expectations.title: The other two `in air` rows join the same substance
expectations.comment: Neither row carries a registry number, so between them they minted `Carbon Dioxide, In Air` — a substance named for a compartment, which is a thing this list holds in the context and not in the name. Curated targets take both to `Carbon Dioxide (biogenic)`; what they do **not** yet fix is the compartment, and the file's own note says so: BAFU files them under `resources / biotic` and `resources / unspecified`, which map to `Resource → Biotic` and `Resource → Ground`. Carbon dioxide taken from the air is neither. That is BAFU's own classification carried faithfully, and correcting it would mean overruling a source's compartment on the strength of a flow name — a general question this change does not settle. #135 stays open for it.

expectations.title: BAFU's land-transformation carbon dioxide picks up EF's +1
expectations.comment: The rows in this whole family that changed a score. `land transformation` is BAFU's spelling of the carbon EF calls `land use change` and ecoinvent books as `from soil or biomass stock`; the qualifier vocabulary matched on `land use` and so read neither row as anything, and both landed on unqualified carbon dioxide, which this list characterises nowhere. A BAFU inventory that cleared land scored zero for it. Both now reach the flow where EF states +1 and ecoinvent agrees.

expectations.title: BAFU's unqualified carbon dioxide is published as fossil
expectations.comment: 14 exchanges of 5,635, on one flow id distinct from `Carbon dioxide, fossil`, always an emission to air. Where real mass sits behind it, it is provably fossil, and BAFU's own published EF 3.1 result puts the mass in `Climate change (fossil)` at CF 1 — so mapping it to an uncharacterised substance would break their quicklime-with-CCS dataset by a factor of four rather than being neutral. Any residual doubt is score-neutral at the aggregate: EF gives fossil and land-use-change carbon dioxide the same +1 under `Climate change`.

expectations.title: The same for the row carrying thirteen of the fourteen exchanges
expectations.comment: Air / unspecified, and the bulk of the population. Stated separately from its `low. pop.` sibling because the two are curated one row at a time and a single claim covering both would pass while one of them regressed.

expectations.title: No source row in any list reaches unqualified carbon dioxide
expectations.comment:
The whole family's shape in one claim. Seven flows, all of them EF's own — three soil and four water — and the three this project had minted for source rows are gone with the rows that made them. The substance survives because EF ships it; what it stops being is a bucket this list fills. It is characterised by nobody, which is the right answer for carbon dioxide that declines to say where its carbon came from.

Unmet on the first five-list full build (2 September 2026, `944b274`, merge run `b348667251b34a60af31b157950e9d32`): nine flows, the two extra minted in air by AGRIBALYSE's plain `Carbon dioxide` rows (#194). Pending until that is ruled.
